pr_title: drivers: espi: xec: Reduce buffer allocation to minimum required
pr_body:
Reduce buffer allocation to minimum required to reduce RAM usage
Optimize eSPI buffer allocation to minimum required per eSPI specification.
Note that flash buffer size could be reduce further to 64 bytes only since it's maximum supported in current eSPI host.

Also add fix #32457

issue_context.title: samples: drivers: espi: Need to handle failures in temperature retrieval
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
The current sample code assumes there are no failures while retrieving temperature over eSPI OOB channel

**Describe the solution you'd like**
If N consecutive attempts fail then it exist the thread and indicate the failure

**Impact**
If sample code ever gets into CI it would hang if any failing conditions

review_comments: No. If the channel are disabled it's not possible to reach this point

this shouldnt be coved with #ifdef CONFIG_ESPI_OOB_CHANNEL ?
assume that espi driver comliped with oob disabled

Yes, it could help reduce further the RAM when OOB channel is not enabled
Not the case in most systems as you know.
Since OOB and Flash channels are by default enabled as desired in the driver is a bit of overkill to fill the driver code with ifdefs all around. I see it as nice to have, but will add it
